item.title: Kataib Hezbollah: What to Know
item.description: A commander of one of the most-hard line and powerful Iranian proxies in Iraq has been charged with plotting to attack Jewish sites in the United States.

item.title: Death toll from Israeli strikes on Lebanon passes 3,000, officials say
item.description: It marks a grim milestone in the conflict between Israel and the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah since March, despite a nominal ceasefire.

item.title: Hezbollah support endures in south Lebanon as ceasefire fails to stop war with Israel
item.description: Despite continuing Israeli attacks and occupation, many people in the south still believe the armed group is the only force capable of defending them.

item.title: Board of Peace will ask the UN Security Council to press Hamas to disarm
item.description: The body overseeing the U.S.-brokered ceasefire in Gaza plans to ask the United Nations Security Council to press Hamas to disarm

item.title: Middle East war live: Chinese, South Korean oil tankers pass through Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Three oil tankers – two Chinese and one South Korean – crossed the Strait of Hormuz Wednesday, according to maritime tracking data, as Iran threatened to open “new fronts” if the US resumed strikes. President Donald Trump is set to attend the G7 summit in France next month, despite tensions between Washington and its allies on the Iran war. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.

item.title: Hamas confirms top commander killed in Israeli air strike
item.description: Friday's strike is the latest launched by Israel on Gaza despite a ceasefire with Hamas.

item.title: Trump says 20-year nuclear programme suspension by Iran would be enough
item.description: The US president says Tehran has to show "real" commitment to removing nuclear fuel and stopping uranium enrichment.

item.title: Early War Goal Was to Install Hard Line Former President as Iran’s Leader
item.description: An Israeli strike designed to free Mahmoud Ahmadinejad from house arrest in Tehran, U.S. officials said, was part of an effort to bring about regime change and put him in power.

item.title: Iran warns of war ‘beyond the region’ if US resumes attacks
item.description: Iran has warned the United States against resuming attacks, threatening to open new fronts if the current ceasefire ends following remarks from Donald Trump that the US may have to deliver another “big hit” against Tehran. Meanwhile, Iranian civilians are preparing for a new flare-up, as negotiations have yet to lead to any concrete decisions.

item.title: Israeli attacks in Gaza have stepped up since halt in bombing in Iran
item.description: At least five Palestinians were killed in Israeli strikes on the Gaza Strip on May 17. Israel has stepped up attacks in Gaza in the weeks since halting its ​joint bombing ‌with the US in Iran. Netanyahu's government says Hamas fighters are tightening their grip on the strip. The devastated Palestinian territory has seen near-daily Israeli fire since the ceasefire between Israel and Hamas went into effect in October.
